newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico revises Jan, Feb and March trade numbers.
newsitem.headline: Mexico revises Jan, Feb and March trade numbers.

text.p: Mexico's Finance Ministry revised on Monday the trade figures for January, February and March.

For January, the trade surplus was revised up to $520 million from $460 million, for February it was revised up to $383 million from $323 million, and for March it was revised down to $611 million from $636 million, the ministry said.

"The revisions correspond principally to export operations of the (in-bond) maquiladora industry. For March, the data also incorporates new information of transactions of the non-maquiladora manufacturing industry," the ministry said in a statement.
